name: Market consensus probabilities sum to 1.0
description: The consensus row is the arithmetic mean of the de-vigged probabilities across all books, so it must itself be a valid probability distribution summing to 1.0. A consensus that sums above 1.0 indicates it was averaged from raw (vigged) numbers or from decimal odds.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match-odds/<first-id>.json using the captured id
Read the consensus.home, consensus.draw and consensus.away values

Verify the three consensus probabilities sum to 1.0 within plus or minus 0.001. A sum meaningfully above 1.0 (e.g. ~1.05, the overround) means consensus was computed on vigged probabilities and fails.
